name: Greystar
why: Largest US apartment manager (catalog ~950,000 units); residents pay through the community's resident portal/app.

name: MAA (Mid-America Apartment Communities)
why: Major Sunbelt apartment REIT (~100,000 homes); MyMAA resident portal.

name: AvalonBay Communities (Avalon Access)
why: Large coastal apartment REIT (~90,000 homes) with its own Avalon Access resident portal.

name: Equity Residential
why: Large urban apartment REIT (~80,000 homes) with its own resident portal.

name: Camden Property Trust (MyCamden)
why: Large Sunbelt apartment REIT (~58,000 homes) with its own MyCamden portal.

name: Invitation Homes
why: Largest single-family rental landlord (~80,000+ homes); distinctive rules (AutoPay only on the 1st, no partial payments).

name: Progress Residential
why: Major single-family rental landlord (~90,000 homes) with documented pay-by-phone, text-to-pay and cash options.

name: New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA)
why: Largest US public housing authority (~145,000 households); city-run online rent payment with published card fees.

name: UDR
why: Large apartment REIT (~60,000 homes) with the UDR Resident app; replaces Essex, whose public resident pages block automated reading (HTTP 429) and RentCafe login is behind a bot wall.
